Recommendation: owner-controlled5% production rollout with exposure/recurrence monitoring before expansion; no rollout performed or authorized. Keep all fixes production_verified=false and retain API/exposure gap; AI SDLC delivery attestation remains unsupported. No rebuild indicated by this observation.
